scripts.open:dev: pnpm sync:dev && npx cap open android
scripts.open:stage: pnpm sync:stage && npx cap open android
scripts.open:staging: pnpm sync:stage && npx cap open android
scripts.open:prod: pnpm sync:prod && npx cap open android
scripts.build:dev: dotenv -q -o -e ../../.env.development -e .env.development -- bash -c 'npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug'

scripts.build:staging: dotenv -q -o -e ../../.env.staging -e .env.staging -- bash -c 'npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease'
scripts.build:prod: dotenv -q -o -e ../../.env.production -e .env.production -- bash -c 'npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease'
scripts.run:android: pnpm sync:android && npx cap run android
scripts.run:dev: pnpm sync:dev && npx cap run android
scripts.run:stage: pnpm sync:stage && npx cap run android
scripts.run:staging: pnpm sync:stage && npx cap run android
scripts.run:prod: pnpm sync:prod && npx cap run android
